description: Several EU member states quietly launch a joint initiative to attract and retain top AI researchers, offering competitive salaries, research independence, and long-term residency. The program is framed as a 'European AI Fellowship' and targets talent from both the US and China, exploiting growing dissatisfaction with export controls and political scrutiny in both jurisdictions. It begins with modest funding but gains momentum as early recruits publish high-impact work under EU auspices.
